datasets.name: DSALLMain
datasets.sql:
select c_d.rowid,c_s.rowid,
ins_ins.name as insname,
cust.name as  custname ,
c.policy_num ,
c_d.claim_num,c_d.EMPL_ACC,
c_d.claim_date,
c_d.final_amount_loss,nvl(final_payment_amount_loss,0) asfinal_payment_amount_loss,
c.kli_id,
c_d.type,
c_d.id,
c_d.cid,c.state,c_d.subraqasiya,im.insuredstatenum,
nvl(c_s.status,0) as status,case nvl(c_s.status,0)when 0 then 'Arasdirilir'when 1 then 'imtina'else   'Odenis'end as statusu
from ins_claim_description c_d,
     ins_contracts c,
     customers cust,
     ins_customers ins_cust,
     ins_insurances ins_ins,ins_claim_status c_s,ins_motorkasco im
where c_d.cid=c.id
and  c.kli_id=ins_cust.id
and  ins_cust.cust_id=cust.id
and ins_ins.id=c_d.type
and c_s.dep_id(+)=c_d.id
and im.cid(+)=c.id

      i_c.surname||' '||i_c.name||' '||i_c.fathername||' '||  CASE i_c.sex WHEN 0 THEN 'oğluna' WHEN 1 THEN 'qızına' END as name1
from ins_claim_description c_d,
     ins_claim_status c_s,

where c_d.id=:pid

datasets.name: DSSigortaAkt
datasets.sql:
select policy_num,i_c.surname||' '||i_c.name||' '||i_c.fathername||' '||  CASE i_c.sex
 WHEN 1 THEN 'oğlu' WHEN 2 THEN 'qızı' when 0 Then '' END as name1,
 
c_d.driver /* ||' '||  CASE i_c.sex  WHEN 1 THEN 'oğlu' WHEN 2 THEN 'qızı' when 0 Then '' END*/ as driver,
im.insuredmark||' '||insuredmodel as marka,im.insuredstatenum,im.INSUREDBANNUM||' '||im.UNDERFRAMENUM as sassi,im.INSUREDENGINENUM,
ie_ac.name as qezaemektasi,c.begin_date||'-'||c.end_date as tarix,c.inssumm,c_d.amortizasiya_ammount,

(select count(*) from ins_claim_description where cid=c.id) as say,
CASE (select count(*) from ins_claim_description where cid=c.id) 
WHEN 0 THEN '' 
WHEN 1 THEN '(Bir) ' 
WHEN 2 THEN '(İki) ' 
WHEN 3 THEN '(Üç) ' 
WHEN 4 THEN '(Dörd) ' 
WHEN 5 THEN '(Beş) '
WHEN 6 THEN '(Alti) ' 
WHEN 7 THEN '(Yeddi) ' 
WHEN 8 THEN '(Sekkiz) ' 
WHEN 9 THEN '(Doqquz) '  
WHEN 10 THEN '(On) ' 
END as sayyazi,
im.DRIVECOST as avtodeyer,c_d.VALUE_NEW_SPARE_PARTS as yeni_e_deyeri,c.franshiz,c_d.claim_date,c_d.region||', '||c_d.STREET as unvan,
c_d.detail,c_d.DRIVER  as texsirlisexs,c_d.MANAGEMENT_RIGHTS as idareetmehuququ,c_d.AVTOSERVIS as servis,c_d.AUTO_ASSESS_COSTS,c_d.UTO_TRANSPORTATION_COSTS,
c_d.OTHER_COSTS,c_d.FINAL_AMOUNT_LOSS,cust.name as custname,i_d_c.name as Qarsi_teref_s_teskilat,c_d.INS_AGAINST_POLISN_DAT,
im.EXTRAFRANSHIZ as zerer,c_d.AUTO_REAL_MARKET_VALUE as realbazardeyeri,c_d.REMAINS_VALUE as qaliq ,c_d.BANK_ACCNO as hesb,
(nvl(c_d.AUTO_REAL_MARKET_VALUE,0)-((nvl(c_d.AUTO_REAL_MARKET_VALUE,0)*nvl(im.EXTRAFRANSHIZ,0))/100)-nvl(c_d.REMAINS_VALUE,0)) as odenismeblegi ,c_d.FINAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT_LOSS,
c_d.person||'(sürücü) - '||c_d.ins_against_owner||'(mülkiyyətçi) - '  as baredinde_req_tele_suru_wexs,(round((c.inssumm/im.drivecost),3)*100) as avt_r_deyer_s_mebleqe_nisbeti,
(c_d.auto_real_market_value*im.extrafranshiz)/100 as Tam_mehv_frans_mebleqi,im.extrafranshiz


from ins_claim_description c_d,
ins_contracts c,
ins_customers i_c,


ins_motorkasco im,ins_dict_employee_accident ie_ac,customers cust,ins_dict_companie i_d_c
where c_d.cid=c.id
and im.cid=c.id
and i_c.id=c.kli_id
and c_d.EMPL_ACC=ie_ac.id
and cust.id=i_c.cust_id
and c_d.INS_AGAINST_ORGANIZATION=i_d_c.id(+)
and c_d.id=:pid
